frozenPredeclaredWindows.objectCoordinates: u,v normalized to each independently registered complete table exterior, including any visible frame; xMin,xMax,yMin,yMax
frozenPredeclaredWindows.registration: Map frozen envelopes through actual study-pane bounds (plotting area, excluding axes). Register the complete table exterior using all visible boundary segments, independent of text/model. Missing/ambiguous boundaries hold that property; never move/enlarge an envelope after inspection. All body/text/divider/frame coordinates are local to the named object, never a union of tables.
frozenPredeclaredWindows.textRule: All glyphs of the exact named literal must be readable in its own frozen window; presence elsewhere or partial/inferred text gives zero credit.

windowFindings.envelope: Complete original top-right envelope is clear: no blue MOVED body or MOVED glyph at that position.

windowFindings.body: Complete separate blue body at middle-right with all exterior boundaries readable.
windowFindings.text/completeText: Complete literal MOVED independently read in its own body.

windowFindings.body: Complete separate orange body at bottom-right with all exterior boundaries readable.
windowFindings.text/completeText: Complete literal CONTROL independently read in its own body.

namedWindows.finding: Complete original top-right envelope is clear: no blue MOVED body or MOVED glyph at that position.
Complete separate blue body at middle-right with all exterior boundaries readable.
Complete literal MOVED independently read in its own body.
Complete separate orange body at bottom-right with all exterior boundaries readable.
Complete literal CONTROL independently read in its own body.

pixelCoverageRule: Conservative original pixel cells intersecting each continuous fixed window: floor minima, ceil maxima exclusive; full row RLE and raw channel histogram, no color conversion or synthetic alpha
scope: Complete per-object fixed envelopes, exterior registration, body/text/individual frame bands/divider strips; raw scan pointers do not complete unreadable glyphs or infer occluded structures.
